original_ai_output.title_zh: 澳门与莫桑比克金融情报机构将签署反洗钱合作备忘录
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 澳门政府宣布，将与莫桑比克金融情报办公室（GIFiM）签署谅解备忘录，交换金融信息以打击洗钱、恐怖融资及大规模杀伤性武器扩散。该命令由行政长官岑浩辉于10月12日签署，保安司司长可授权警察总局局长代表签署。报道称澳门金融情报办公室此前已与33个国家和地区签署信息交换协议。

key_facts.fact: 澳门与莫桑比克将签署反洗钱和反恐融资信息交换协议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Macau and Mozambique will sign an agreement to exchange information to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing

key_facts.fact: 协议涉及打击洗钱、关联上游犯罪、恐怖融资及大规模杀伤性武器扩散
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the protocol involves the exchange of “financial information” to combat money laundering, “associated predicate offences”, terrorist financing and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

key_facts.fact: 备忘录将与莫桑比克金融情报办公室（GIFiM）签署
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The memorandum of understanding will be signed with Mozambique’s Financial Information Office (GIFiM)

key_facts.fact: 相关命令由行政长官岑浩辉于10月12日签署
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: signed by the Chief Executive, Sam Hou Fai, on 12 October

key_facts.fact: 澳门金融情报办公室已与33个国家和地区签署信息交换协议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Macau’s GIF has signed information-exchange agreements with 33 countries and territories

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Club of Mozambique）报道，尚未获得交叉验证
协议具体签署时间尚未公布
